title: Vertebral morphometry
summary: bordercall's morphometry engine measures every vertebra of a mask into rows of a table.
does: bordercall's morphometry engine, the copy pinned under grid/bordercall/ and imported by path, measures each labelled vertebra of a CT's mask into a row: its level and its measurements. The rows stay on the grid and only aggregates leave (logs/MORPHOMETRY-<set>.md). Today the word runs it over the gold tier 3 masks as two CPU jobs, enhance and verse (grid/morphometry.sbatch: 32 CPUs, 64 GB, 24 h); morphometry covariates then joins each person's sex and age.

outputs.name: table
outputs.what: One row per vertebra: its level and its measurements.

params.name: collection
params.what: the word's set: ENHANCE.PET's label maps, or VerSe's with TotalSegmentator's

generic.why: It measures labelled 3-D masks (grid/bordercall/); a frame or a clip has no vertebra to measure in 3-D. The probe test hands it unlabelled volumes too, so the pattern does not ask for masks; a volume without one gives no rows.

today.note: also morphometry verse, and morphometry covariates once both end 0
